name: BCG
recent: Big Caring Group 于2026年11月19日在Bursa Malaysia主板上市，IPO涉及发售现有股及新股。上市后出现大股东股权变动，Creador相关股东减持。公司计划未来三至五年每年新开40至50家门店，并拨出RM30m用于配送中心土地。
notable: 公司于2026年11月19日在Bursa Malaysia主板上市，IPO涉及献售现有股及公开发行新股。
Creador相关股东以11.09亿股献售方式减持Big Caring股权。
公司计划未来三至五年每年新开40至50家门店。
risks: Creador相关股东通过献售11.09亿股减持股权。
公司与Brego Life Sciences的经常性关联交易金额超过1%比率。
公司披露约RM11 million的关联方交易。

recent_en: Big Caring Group listed on Bursa Malaysia's Main Market on 19 November 2026 via an IPO involving existing and new shares. Post-listing, there were changes in substantial shareholder interests, with a Creador-linked shareholder reducing its stake. The company plans to open 40 to 50 new outlets annually over the next three to five years and has set aside RM30m for distribution centre land.
notable_en: The company listed on Bursa Malaysia's Main Market on 19 November 2026, with the IPO comprising an offer for sale of existing shares and a public issue of new shares.
A Creador-linked shareholder reduced its stake in Big Caring through an offer for sale of 1.09 billion shares.
The company plans to open 40 to 50 new outlets annually over the next three to five years.
risks_en: A Creador-linked shareholder reduced its stake via an offer for sale of 1.09 billion shares.
The company's recurrent related party transactions with Brego Life Sciences exceeded the 1% percentage ratio.
The company disclosed approximately RM11 million in related-party transactions.
earnings_en: For the third quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM1,113,164,000 and net income was RM72,516,000, with a net margin of 6.5%.
